vectors.name: accepted_absence
vectors.description: An honest absence proof is accepted: the walk ends at a divergence the nodes themselves prove.

vectors.name: accepted_inclusion
vectors.description: An honest inclusion proof is accepted and the leaf value is bound exactly.

vectors.name: branch_value_on_path
vectors.description: A branch that stores a value while the key continues past it is refused.

vectors.name: empty_extension
vectors.description: An extension with an empty path adds no key material and is refused.

vectors.name: flipped_byte
vectors.description: One flipped byte anywhere breaks the keccak link to the parent reference.

vectors.name: hexprefix_padding
vectors.description: An even-length hex-prefix path with a nonzero padding nibble is non-canonical and refused.

vectors.name: leaf_before_key_end
vectors.description: A leaf that ends before the key is consumed proves a different key, not this one.

vectors.name: overlong_path
vectors.description: A leaf path longer than the remaining key is refused instead of being silently clipped.

vectors.name: oversized_inline_node
vectors.description: An embedded child large enough to hold a hash reference: a lenient decoder reads it as a valid inclusion, canonical Ethereum never emits it, and Assay refuses it outright.

vectors.name: short_child_reference
vectors.description: A child reference that is not exactly 32 bytes cannot be a keccak hash and is refused.

vectors.name: trailing_nodes
vectors.description: Nodes after the terminal node are refused; padding a proof must not change its meaning.

vectors.name: truncated_proof
vectors.description: The proveth-class attack: a proof cut short before its terminal node must never read as absence.
